hosting.title: Hosting and technical logs
hosting.body: The website is intended to be hosted by Netlify. When a page is requested, technically necessary connection data may be processed in server logs, including the IP address, time, requested resource and browser information. The purpose, legal basis, processing location and retention period must be confirmed against the final hosting configuration and commissioned agreements.

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.body: When an enquiry is submitted, the name, email address, message, language and timestamp are processed, along with the optional company, telephone number and requested service. These details are used solely to handle the enquiry. The precise legal basis and internal retention period must be defined before production launch. The website does not store a copy of the enquiry in its own application database.

emailDelivery.title: Email delivery
emailDelivery.body: Resend is intended to deliver enquiries to the business inbox. The approved form data is processed as an email for this purpose; the visitor's address is used only as the reply address. No automatic confirmation email is sent. Contractual, retention and transfer details must be legally reviewed before production launch.

rateLimiting.title: Protection against abusive enquiries
rateLimiting.body: A technical rate limit using Upstash Redis is planned to protect the form. IP and email addresses are transformed into identifiers that are not directly readable using a secret HMAC key before transfer. Redis receives only those identifiers and short-lived counters for the limiting windows. The final configuration and legal basis must be confirmed.

cookies.title: Cookies, analytics and external content
cookies.body: The current website uses no non-essential cookies and embeds no analytics, marketing or map services. It therefore displays no cookie banner. If such services are added later, they must be integrated into an effective consent system before loading and this policy must be updated.

retention.title: Retention and legal bases
retention.body: Specific retention periods, deletion procedures and legal bases for inbox data and technical logs are not invented here. Barbara GmbH and its legal counsel must define them based on actual business processes, contracts and legal obligations.

rights.title: Data subject rights
rights.body: Information about access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection, withdrawal and complaint rights must be added in the final form applicable to Barbara GmbH. Future requests should be directed to the approved privacy contact.
